items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: Yeah, I think Dick had just started playing with us then.

ctx.x: I was wondering about the nature of that particular occasion of that photograph at the Chess Checkers.

Well, it was an old script dance. I don't know who promoted it. We used to have two or three people that made a living out of it, that kept themselves in school by giving these script dances every once in a while. Most of them were given a two-lane gym, the old gym. But this happened to be one given down what was then the Cosmopolitan Hotel, and it went all the way through from Bourbon to Royal Street. It went completely through the block. But the part on Bourbon Street was called the Chess and Checkers Club.…
You wouldn't know that I was a fiddle.
